narrative.overview: NgaanBaan Board is designed as a focused, high-density engineering workspace built to minimize cognitive strain during intense sprint planning and daily standups.

rules.name: The Rarity of Primary Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo accent fills are reserved exclusively for primary CTAs, active selection states, and focus rings.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: All timestamps, task IDs, numbers, and counts must use the .tabular-nums utility class.

rules.name: The Border-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are defined by crisp 1px borders and subtle background contrast.

dos: Do maintain high contrast between text and background in both light and dark modes.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to numbers, task counts, and timestamps.
Do keep interactive touch/click targets to a minimum of 36x36px with rounded-xl boundaries.
donts: Don't use heavy, dark, diffuse drop shadows that muddy the card layout.
Don't mix unstyled system sans-serif fonts; always utilize IBM Plex Sans Thai with fallback stacks.
Don't use colored left/right accent borders over 1px on task cards.
